paite: Huchi in mite vaihawmte Jerusalem ah ateng ua: midangte'n leng, khopi siangthou Jerusalem a teng ding sawm lak a khat leh khopi dangte a teng dia seh kuate theihna ding in ai asan uhi.
heading: Jerusalem A Tengte
english: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

paite: Mite'n Jerusalem a teng ding a uttak a amau leh amau kipete tengteng avualzawlta uhi.
english: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem a teng bial sung a hausate hiaite ahi uh; himahleh Judah khopite ah michih amau khopite uah michih atan chiat uah amau ateng ua, huaite, Israel siampute, Levi mite leh Nethinim mite leh Solomon sikhate tate.
english: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah, everyone lived in his possession in their cities—Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

paite: Jerusalem ah Judah tate lak a leh Benjamin tate lak a kuate hiam ateng uhi. Judah tate lak ah: Athaiah Uzziah tapa, Zekariah tapa, Amariah tapa, Shephatiah tapa, Mahalalel tapa, Perez tate lak ah;
english: Some of the children of Judah and of the children of Benjamin lived in Jerusalem. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

paite: Maaseiah Baruk tapa, Kolhozeh tapa, Hazaiah tapa, Adaiah tapa, Joiarib tapa, Zekariah tapa, Shiloni tapa.
english: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

paite: Jerusalem a teng Perez tapate tengteng pasal hangsan ngen zali sawmguk-le-giat ahi uh.
english: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

paite: Hiaite Benjamin tapate ahi uh: Sallu, Meshullam tapa, Joed tapa, Pedaiah tapa, Kolaiah tapa, Maaseiah tapa, Ithiel tapa, Jeshaiah tapa.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

paite: Huai nung in Gabbai, Sallai, zakua sawmnih-le-giat.
english: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Huan Zikri tapa Joel aheutu uh ahi: huan Senuah tapa Judah khopi tung a nihna ahi.
english: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

paite: Siampute lak ah: Joiarib tapa Jedaiah, Jakin tapa,
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

paite: Hilkiah tapa Seraiah, Meshullam tapa, Zadok tapa, Meraioth tapa, Ahitub tapa, Pathian inn a vaihawm,
english: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,

paite: leh a-unaute uh huai inn a nasep sem, zagiat sawmnih-le-nih: huan Jeroham tapa Adaiah, Pelaliah tapa, Amzi tapa, Zekariah tapa, Pashur tapa, Malkijah tapa,
english: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

paite: leh a-unaute, pipute inkote hausate, zanih sawmli-le-nih: huan Azarel tapa Amashai, Ahzai tapa, Mesillemoth tapa, Immer tapa,
english: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

paite: leh a-unaute uh, mihat hangsante, za-le-sawmnih-le-giat: huan aheutu uh Zabdiel, Haggedolim tapa ahi.
english: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

paite: Levi mite lak ah: Hassub tapa Shemaiah, Azrikam tapa, Hashabiah tapa, Bunni tapa;
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

paite: Shabbethai leh Jozabad, Levi mite hausate lak a, Pathian inn polam nasep a heutu;
english: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;

paite: Mika tapa Mattaniah, Zabdi tapa, Asaph tapa, thumna a kipahthu genna pankhe pipen ahi. Huan Bakbukiah, a-unaute lak a nihna; huan Shammua tapa Abda, Galal tapa, Jeduthun tapa.
english: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

paite: Khopi siangthou sung a Levi mite tengteng zanih sawmgiat-le-li.
english: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.

paite: Huai ban ah kongkhak ngakte, Akkub, Talmon leh a-unaute uh kongpite ngakte, za sawmsagih-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: Moreover the gatekeepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.

paite: Huan Israel lak a omlaite, siampute lak a Levi mite, Judah khopite tengteng ah a-om ua, michih agouluahna chiat uah.
english: The residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

paite: Himahleh Ophel ah Nethinim mite ateng uh; huan mite tung ah Ziha leh Gispa Nethinim a-om uhi.
english: But the temple servants lived in Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

paite: Jerusalem a Levi mite heutu leng Bani tapa Uzzi ahi, Hashabiah tapa, Mattaniah tapa, Mika tapa, Asaph tapate, Pathian inn a nasepna a lasa mite;
english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers responsible for the service of God’s house.

paite: amau tungtang thu ah kumpipa a kipan a thupiak, niteng a akiphamoh bang in; lasa mite a ding a dan kipsa lah a-om ngal a.
english: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

paite: Huan Pethahiah, Meshezabel tapa, Judah tapa Zerah tate lak a mipite tungtang thu tengteng amah kumpipa khut ah a-om hi.
english: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

paite: Khuate, aloute uh toh ahihleh, Judah tate lak a akhenkhatte Kiriatharba leh akhotate ah, Dibon leh akhotate ah, Jekabzeel leh akhotate ah ateng ua;
heading: Kholian Leh Khopi Dang A Tengte
english: As for the villages with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, in Dibon and its towns, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

paite: Jeshua leh Moladah leh Bethphelet ah;
english: in Jeshua, in Moladah, Beth Pelet,

paite: Hazar-shual leh Beer-sheba leh akhotate ah;
english: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its towns,

paite: Ziklag leh Mekonah leh akhotate ah;
english: in Ziklag, in Meconah and in its towns,

paite: Enrimmon leh Zariah leh Jarmuth ah;
english: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,

paite: Zanoah, Adullam leh akhotate uah, Lakish leh huai aloute, Azekah leh akhotate. Huchi in Beer-sheba a kipan Hinnom Phaizang tan in giahbuk abawl uhi.
english: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

paite: Benjamin tate leng Geba a kipan in atengtou zel ua, Mikmash leh Aija ah, Bethel leh akhotate ah;
english: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,

paite: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah ah;
english: at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

paite: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim;
english: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

paite: Hadid, Zeboim. Neballat;
english: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

paite: Lod leh Ono, khutsiamte phaizang ah.
english: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

paite: Huan Judah a Levi mite sehkhen bangzah hiam Benjamin toh akizom uhi.
english: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.
